decision_conditions: <p>The external materials used in the development shall match those shown on the approved plans and, where no material is specified, shall match the existing building in colour, texture and finish.</p>

<p data-start="284" data-end="587" class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer"><span data-start="284" data-end="587" style="">Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved plans, prior to the occupation of the extended ground floor unit hereby approved, full details of the refuse and recycling facilities shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The submitted details shall include:</span><span aria-hidden="true" class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchor"></span></p><p data-start="592" data-end="674">(a) the location, layout and dimensions of the refuse and recycling storage areas;</p><p data-start="679" data-end="763">(b) the number, type and capacity of refuse and recycling containers to be provided;</p><p data-start="768" data-end="867">(c) arrangements for the storage, segregation, presentation and collection of refuse and recycling;</p><p data-start="872" data-end="1014">(d) details of the ongoing management and maintenance of the refuse and recycling facilities, including responsibilities for their upkeep; and</p><p data-start="1019" data-end="1137">(e) measures to ensure that the refuse and recycling storage areas remain accessible, clean and free from obstruction.</p><p data-start="6705" data-end="6925" class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer">





</p><p data-start="1142" data-end="1352"><span data-start="1142" data-end="1352">The approved refuse and recycling facilities shall be provided prior to the occupation of the extended ground floor unit and shall thereafter be retained and managed in accordance with the approved details.</span></p>

<p>Prior to the occupation of the development hereby approved, a lighting strategy for the retained rear area shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The strategy shall include details of the location, type and specification of the proposed external lighting to demonstrate that the retained rear area will be appropriately illuminated in the interests of safety and security. The approved lighting shall be installed prior to the occupation of the development and shall thereafter be retained and maintained in accordance with the approved details.</p>

<p>Prior to commencement of above-ground works, full details of the proposed biodiverse green roof shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include:</p><p data-start="1998" data-end="2076" class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer">(a) the planting specification, including the proposed wildflower species mix;<span aria-hidden="true" class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchor"></span></p><p data-start="2078" data-end="2114">(b) substrate composition and depth;</p><p data-start="2116" data-end="2175">(c) drainage and irrigation arrangements, where applicable;</p><p data-start="2177" data-end="2290">(d) a management and maintenance plan, including watering and replacement of failed planting where necessary; and</p><p>



</p><p data-start="2292" data-end="2404">(e) measures to ensure the long-term retention of the biodiverse green roof for the lifetime of the development.</p><p data-start="2292" data-end="2404">The biodiverse green roof shall be installed in accordance with the approved details prior to the first occupation of the development and shall thereafter be retained and maintained in accordance with the approved management and maintenance plan for the lifetime of the development.</p>

<p data-start="5555" data-end="5789" class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer">Prior to the occupation of the extended ground floor unit hereby approved, full details of the proposed cycle parking facilities shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include:<span aria-hidden="true" class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchor"></span></p><p data-start="5791" data-end="5852">(a) the dimensions, layout and capacity of the cycle parking;</p><p data-start="5854" data-end="5937">(b) details of the enclosure, including materials, finishes and means of enclosure;</p><p data-start="5939" data-end="5990">(c) the type and specification of the cycle stands;</p><p data-start="5992" data-end="6111">(d) details of security measures, including access arrangements, locking facilities and lighting where appropriate; and</p><p data-start="6113" data-end="6219">(e) details demonstrating that the cycle parking is safe, secure, convenient and accessible for all users.</p><p>





</p><p data-start="6221" data-end="6414">The approved cycle parking facilities shall be provided prior to the occupation of the extended ground floor unit and shall thereafter be retained and kept available for cycle parking purposes.</p>
description: Single storey rear extension; Alterations to shop front; Bin and Cycle stores to rear
